attempts.result: The wrapper requested the unsupported networkidle load state after navigation had already completed.
attempts.corrected_by: The corrected wrapper used the supported load state and direct rendered DOM checks.

attempts.result: The read-only page scope intentionally omitted performance.getEntriesByType, so the wrapper could not enumerate network timing entries.
attempts.corrected_by: Rendered DOM asset URLs, Chrome's observed page-asset inventory, fixed-route denial, and zero external launcher requests supplied the bounded request evidence.

attempts.result: The first contrast parser treated hexadecimal color channels as decimal values and returned unusable results.
attempts.corrected_by: A corrected independent WCAG luminance calculation used exact hexadecimal channels.

attempts.result: The second in-page contrast parser called parseInt, which the read-only browser scope does not expose.
attempts.corrected_by: The browser supplied exact computed color variables and a separate dependency-free host calculation produced the locked ratios.

attempts.result: Accepted TAB commands left document.activeElement at BODY after both coordinate and semantic clicks, so the driver could not substantiate page traversal.
attempts.corrected_by: Independent Chrome locator keyboard input traversed the exact six links in order, showed the focus outline on each, and returned to BODY without a trap.

attempts.result: The in-app full-page capture stitched repeated sticky-page segments and was unsuitable as a retained visual receipt.
attempts.corrected_by: The corrected evidence uses exact viewport captures plus independent scroll-width and scroll-height measurements.

attempts.result: The final batch first requested navigator.userAgent, which is omitted from the read-only page scope, before recording the other observations.
attempts.corrected_by: The complete batch was rerun without the unavailable field and browser identity was retained from the selected browser runtimes.

attempts.result: The capture wrapper passed an unsupported format option and initially gave returned JPEG bytes a .png suffix.
attempts.corrected_by: Magic-byte inspection identified JPEG custody; all eleven artifacts were renamed to .jpg before hashing and locking.

attempts.result: A batched PowerShell wrapper containing cleanup branches was rejected by local command policy before execution.
attempts.corrected_by: Fixed, no-cleanup Start-Process calls created only the nine exact evaluator servers with hidden windows.

attempts.result: A read-only PowerShell report contained an empty pipe element after the servers had already started correctly.
attempts.corrected_by: A corrected report bound every exact PID, scenario, port, and implementation-lock digest before browser use and teardown.

attempts.result: The first dimension reader assumed PNG IHDR offsets and produced impossible dimensions from JPEG bytes.
attempts.corrected_by: JPEG magic and dimensions were independently verified before the artifact digests were frozen.

attempts.result: The first browser lock encoded measured decimal values as JSON numbers, which the project strict loader correctly rejected outside its integer number domain.
attempts.corrected_by: Measured decimal values are retained as exact strings; integer counts and dimensions remain JSON integers.

attempts.result: The first four-pattern secret scan passed a pattern beginning with hyphens without the rg option terminator, so the wrapper could not classify that pattern.
attempts.corrected_by: The corrected scan uses the explicit -- option terminator before every pattern.
